instruction: Inspect evidence.json and write classification.json. The output must contain exactly schema_version and endpoints. schema_version must be 1. endpoints must be an object keyed by every exact endpoint id e01 through e12. Each endpoint value must contain exactly class, evidence_refs, and next_action. class must be one of CONFIRMED_ANONYMOUS, PREAUTH_BOOTSTRAP, ANONYMOUS_READ_CANDIDATE, SESSION_BOUND, UNKNOWN. evidence_refs must be a non-empty sorted array of RFC 6901 JSON pointers into evidence.json, written as evidence.json#<pointer>. next_action must be one of NONE, BOUNDED_ANONYMOUS_PROBE, AUTH_BOUNDARY, RECOVER_MORE_CONTEXT. Use only observable evidence. Do not infer anonymous server access merely because no endpoint-specific auth annotation or session guard was observed. CONFIRMED_ANONYMOUS requires a successful live anonymous probe. PREAUTH_BOOTSTRAP is for endpoints explicitly reachable before a session as part of bootstrap/login establishment; it does not mean unrestricted anonymous read access. ANONYMOUS_READ_CANDIDATE is for read-only endpoints without a proven session requirement that still lack live anonymous qualification. SESSION_BOUND requires observable session/account gating or account-bound mutation. Preserve UNKNOWN when the evidence is conflicting or insufficient. Do not modify fixture files.
